original_description: Aspicio turns DXF CAD drawings into things ChatGPT can work with: structured facts (units, bounds, layers with the colors actually drawn, entity counts, and the drawing's text content), rendered PNG images, and an interactive in-chat viewer with pan, zoom, layer toggles, and fullscreen. Point it at a drawing URL or paste DXF text to read title blocks and dimension values, check layer structure, and visually inspect floor plans, die-cut layouts, and mechanical parts without leaving the conversation.
summary_ja: DXF図面のレイヤーや寸法・文字を確認し、画像や対話型ビューアーで閲覧する。
limitations: 寸法や図面解析の精度・実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
